SHAHBAZ JUNAID Business Analyst | Capital Markets | OTC Derivatives | SQL | UAT | Regulatory Reporting | Agile

Bangalore, India | +91-6363503573 | mohammedaarib777@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business Analyst with 11+ years of experience in derivatives and capital markets, specializing in OTC trade lifecycle, regulatory reporting, and data reconciliation. Expert in requirement elicitation, stakeholder management, UAT, and Agile delivery. Proven ability to drive automation, reduce operational risk, and improve reporting accuracy using SQL, MEDM, and enterprise systems.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Requirement Elicitation, BRD / FRD Documentation Stakeholder Management, UAT, Defect Tracking OTC Trade Lifecycle, Regulatory Reporting Data Mapping, Reconciliation, Process Automation Agile / Scrum, User Stories, Backlog Grooming

TECHNICAL STACK

SQL (Oracle SQL, SQL Server) Market EDM (MEDM) OMNIUM OTC Trade Capture Microsoft ADO, ServiceNow SFTP & Data Integration Systems

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst – Capital Markets (OTC Derivatives) Northern Trust Corporation | Nov 2020 – June 2025

Led requirement gathering, BRD/FRD creation, and stakeholder discussions for derivatives reporting systems Translated business needs into user stories and collaborated with development teams in Agile environment Managed UAT cycles, defect tracking, and production releases ensuring high-quality delivery Automated BVI regulatory reporting achieving 100% compliance and significant manual effort reduction Led migration of derivatives reporting from IIP to DDM, reducing system dependency by 30% and improving performance by 20% Designed SFTP-based file transfer system improving data security by 40% and delivery efficiency by 35% Improved reconciliation workflows reducing reporting errors by 25% Led cross-functional stakeholder discussions across business, operations, and technology teams. Acted as primary point of contact for reporting and production issues.

Senior Derivatives Analyst Northern Trust Corporation | May 2018 – Oct 2020

Managed OTC trade lifecycle including settlements and reconciliations reducing trade breaks by 15% Developed SQL-based data validation solutions improving reporting accuracy by 25% Led static data integration initiatives reducing manual intervention by 20% Supported regulatory reporting and risk compliance processes

Derivatives Analyst Northern Trust Corporation | Oct 2016 – April 2018

Automated OTC trade reporting improving operational efficiency by 20% Conducted data validation and reconciliation ensuring accurate reporting Created process documentation and improved stakeholder communication by 15% Collaborated with technology teams to optimize workflows and reduce errors by 18%

Data Processor Northern Trust Corporation | April 2014 – Sept 2016

Processed high-volume financial transactions reducing errors by 12% Supported trade capture and reconciliation operations Assisted in SQL-based reporting and data retrieval

Desktop Engineer Nestor InfoTech Solutions Pvt Ltd | Mar 2012 – Mar 2014

Provided IT support, system maintenance, and troubleshooting

Technical Support Executive Northern Trust Corporation | Mar 2011 – Feb 2012

Delivered end-user support for hardware, software, and network issues

KEY PROJECTS

BVI Regulatory Reporting Automation

Automated regulatory reporting reducing manual effort and ensuring 100% compliance

Derivatives Reporting Migration (IIP to DDM)

Led migration improving performance by 20% and reducing dependency by 30%

SFTP File Transfer Implementation

Designed secure file transfer solution improving delivery time by 35%

EDUCATION

B.Com – Swami Vivekananda University, Bangalore

CERTIFICATIONS

SQL Certification Oracle Certification MEDM Certification Business Analysis Courses (Udemy)

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, Urdu
